title: Evaluation plan
description: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.4 (Draft); the document wins. Draft: ARIADNE specifies this format and Tillman Heisner freezes its version (section 1.3; D9 A). One version of the evaluation plan (section 4.8): the continuation criteria of section 4.7, rule 4, for Stage 1 held-out assessment, which Tillman Heisner sets, approves and freezes under his interim Stage 1 authority, with the plan's version, its approval and the date of its freeze. A held-out assessment batch references one frozen version by its file reference with checksum (section 7.1, rule 9).
$comment: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.4 (Draft); the document wins. Section 4.8 proposes the key names. The file selects no threshold: criteria hold what Tillman Heisner sets, in plain words. A plan without approval and freeze is a draft, which no held-out assessment may reference; a frozen version holds at least one criterion and is never changed, and a change makes a new version (section 4.8). Meeting the criteria means that the workflow is technically ready for proposing a bounded trial with researchers; it authorizes neither the use of participants' data or effort nor a wider pilot or consortium step (section 4.7, rule 4; OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q8). Not expressed here: that the approver is Tillman Heisner, which the admission check compares; that the file matches the checksum a batch references; whether the criteria are sound, which no check judges (section 7.1, rule 9). The example is illustrative: the version, times and the criterion texts are made up and are not proposed criteria.

criteria.description: The continuation criteria, each in plain words (section 4.7, rule 4). This file sets no threshold.

approved_by.description: The named person who approved the version: Tillman Heisner, under his interim Stage 1 authority (section 4.8).

frozen_on.description: The date the version was frozen; it is never changed after it. Absent while it is a draft.

criteria: <a criterion that Tillman Heisner sets, in plain words>

utc_time.description: A date and time in RFC 3339 form, in UTC, for example 2026-10-20T14:03:00Z (design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1, Timestamps).
